Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjeev Kumar, Judge
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Dhar, Judge
 Order

In compliance to the judgment passed by this Court, communication dated 01.04.2023 under Section 11 sub section (1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act 2013 has been issued.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Mr. Ravinder Gupta, learned AAG appearing on behalf of the Public Works Department submits that requisite funds too have been made available to the Collector concerned.
In view of the aforesaid, the Collector is directed to proceed with the acquisition proceedings and take the same to the logical end within the statutory period.
Let the Collector Land Acquisition file status report by the next date of hearing.

List on 11.12.2024.
 (SANJAY DHAR) (SANJEEV KUMAR)
